item.title: Alleged crime boss Daniel Kinahan’s return to Ireland ends global game of cat-and-mouse
item.summary: Kinahan built boxing empire while in exile in Dubai but now faces trial in Dublin charged with directing organised crime A decade after escaping assassination and fleeing into exile, Daniel Kinahan is on his way back to Ireland – but it is not the homecoming he wanted. The alleged leader of the Kinahan organised crime group was extradited from Dubai in an Irish government jet on Sunday and headed to a huge security operation in Dublin, marking the end of a global game of cat-and-mouse with European, US and Gulf authorities.
